description: Same Padatious engine as padatious-medium, with the plugin's own exact-match regex layer switched off via 'disable_padaos': true: every utterance goes straight to the FastText-similarity IntentContainer match, skipping the padaos regex pre-pass.
notes: Same plugin id and medium-confidence gate as padatious-medium; the only config change is flipping 'disable_padaos' from false to true. padaos is the exact-match regex layer inside padatious (IntentContainer(disable_padaos=...)); this fighter exists to quantify how much accuracy it actually buys, particularly on exact-template-match utterances, versus the training/boot-time cost of maintaining it. Padatious itself is not changing: disable_padaos stays a permanent, opt-in option in the plugin regardless of what these numbers show.
